points.description: Justification: pipe is unidirectional – data written to the write end fd[1] is read from the read end fd[0] (fd[0] is for reading only).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says pipe is one-directional/one-way without naming fd[0] as read and fd[1] as write.

points.description: Justification: the reverse is not possible – cannot write to fd[0] or read from fd[1] (communication only goes from fd[1] to fd[0]).
points.partial_credit: Half if implied only vaguely, e.g. 'only one direction' with no mention of the reverse being disallowed.

rubric.notes: Full marks need TRUE plus a justification that fd[1] is the write end, fd[0] is the read end, and the pipe is one-directional so the reverse does not work. If the student says TRUE with no correct justification, give 0 overall. Give part marks for a vague or half-stated justification; give 0 for FALSE or for swapping the roles of fd[0] and fd[1].
